title: potentilla glandulifera subsp. virescens
intro: Potentilla glandulifera subsp. virescens, commonly known as Chinese or Asian potentilla, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antiseptic activities, as well as its potential to lower blood sugar levels and improve immune function. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla glandulifera subsp. virescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
